import os

from claude_agent_sdk import ClaudeAgentOptions, query

options = ClaudeAgentOptions(
    mcp_servers={
        "inflect": {
            "type": "http",
            "url": "https://inflect.acme.example/api/mcp",
            "headers": {"Authorization": "Bearer " + os.environ["INFLECT_API_KEY"]},
        }
    },
    allowed_tools=[
        "mcp__inflect__list_risks",
        "mcp__inflect__propose_risks",
    ],
    tools=[],
    setting_sources=[],
    strict_mcp_config=True,
    permission_mode="dontAsk",
)


async def main() -> None:
    async for message in query(prompt="Summarise our open risks.", options=options):
        print(message)
